runs.prompt: Add a method Clear to Cart in cart/cart.go that removes every line, and test it.
runs.finalMessage:
Added `Cart.Clear()` to remove every line and `TestClear` to cover a populated cart, an empty cart, and adding a line afterward.

`go test ./...` and `ostf check --base main` pass. The check lists **R-CART-CLEAR** (new draft requirement, verified by `TestClear`) and **N-BUY** (still true). It also reports pre-existing unlinked **R-ORDER-NOTE** and **R-VOLUME-DISCOUNT**; this change leaves both unaffected. No risk relevant item was touched.

runs.prompt: Add a method Preview to Checkout in cart/checkout.go that takes the same session token, cart and discount as PlaceOrder and returns the quote that PlaceOrder would charge, without reserving stock or charging. Test it.
runs.finalMessage:
Added `Checkout.Preview(token, cart, discount)` in [checkout.go](/private/tmp/ostf-trials/phase5/codex.full.go-shop.T12.1/run-02/repo/cart/checkout.go). It shares PlaceOrder’s session validation and pricing, returns the quote, and neither reserves stock nor charges. The new draft trace item is `R-CHECKOUT-PREVIEW`.

`go test ./...` and `ostf check --base main` passed. The trace check lists `R-CHECKOUT-PREVIEW`, `R-CHECKOUT-ORDER`, and `R-CHECKOUT-SESSION`, with their parent needs `N-FAIR-PRICE`, `N-BUY`, and `N-ACCOUNT-SAFE`; the change keeps each true. It lists `TestPreview`, `TestPreviewRejectsInvalidInput`, `TestPlaceOrder`, and `TestPlaceOrderNeedsSession`. No risk-relevant item was touched.

runs.prompt: Add a method Held to Stock in inventory/inventory.go that returns the units of a SKU that unexpired reservations hold, and test it.
runs.finalMessage:
Added `Stock.Held(sku)` in [inventory.go](/tmp/ostf-trials/phase5/codex.full.go-shop.T12.1/run-03/repo/inventory/inventory.go). It sums the SKU’s units across unexpired reservations. [TestHeld](/tmp/ostf-trials/phase5/codex.full.go-shop.T12.1/run-03/repo/inventory/inventory_test.go) covers multiple reservations, other SKUs, and the exact expiry boundary.

`go test ./...` and `ostf check --base main` pass. The check lists the new draft item **R-STOCK-HELD** and its test, `TestHeld`; the change keeps its parent need **N-NO-OVERSELL** true. It also reports **R-ORDER-NOTE** and **R-VOLUME-DISCOUNT** as preexisting unlinked items; neither was changed. No risk-relevant item was touched.

runs.prompt: Add a method Logout to Sessions in accounts/session.go that ends a session, so that validating its token afterwards fails with ErrNoSession. Test it.
runs.finalMessage:
Added `Sessions.Logout(token)` to end a session. `TestLogout` confirms that validating the token afterward returns `ErrNoSession`, including after a repeated logout.

Added draft trace item `R-SESSION-LOGOUT`, refining `N-ACCOUNT-SAFE`; the change keeps both items true. `go test ./...` and `ostf check --base origin/main` pass. The trace check still reports two pre-existing unlinked items.

runs.prompt: Add a method Total to AuditLog in payments/audit.go that returns the sum of the amounts of one account's entries for one action, such as "charge" or "refund". Test it.
runs.finalMessage:
Added `AuditLog.Total(account, action)` in [payments/audit.go](/private/tmp/ostf-trials/phase5/codex.full.go-shop.T12.1/run-05/repo/payments/audit.go). It sums matching amounts under the log’s mutex and returns zero when there are no matches.

`go test ./...` passes. `ostf check --base origin/main` passes with no errors. Its impact report lists **R-AUDIT-APPEND-ONLY** and **N-ACCOUNT-SAFE**, which remain true, and the new draft **R-AUDIT-TOTAL**, which the change satisfies. It lists [payments/audit_test.go](/private/tmp/ostf-trials/phase5/codex.full.go-shop.T12.1/run-05/repo/payments/audit_test.go), including `TestAuditTotal`, as the relevant tests.

runs.prompt: Add a method Expired to Discount in pricing/discount.go that reports whether the code has expired at a given time, and test it.
runs.finalMessage:
Added `Discount.Expired(now)` in [pricing/discount.go](/private/tmp/ostf-trials/phase5/codex.full.go-shop.T12.1/run-06/repo/pricing/discount.go). It returns true at the expiry instant and afterward.

`TestDiscountExpired` covers before, at, and after expiry. `go test ./...` and `ostf check --base main` pass. The trace check lists **R-DISCOUNT-EXPIRY**, which remains true, and names `TestDiscountExpired` and `TestApplyDiscount/rejects_expired`.

runs.prompt: Add a function ParseMoney to pricing/money.go that parses an amount such as 12.05 into Money and rejects more than two decimal places. Test it.
runs.finalMessage:
Added `ParseMoney(string) (Money, error)` in [pricing/money.go](/private/tmp/ostf-trials/phase5/codex.full.go-shop.T12.1/run-07/repo/pricing/money.go). It converts decimal text to integer cents and rejects more than two decimal places, malformed input, and overflow.

[TestParseMoney](/private/tmp/ostf-trials/phase5/codex.full.go-shop.T12.1/run-07/repo/pricing/money_test.go) covers valid amounts and rejections. `go test ./...` and `ostf check --base main` pass. The check lists the new draft R-MONEY-PARSE, plus R-MONEY-CENTS and N-FAIR-PRICE; the change keeps all three true. No risk relevant item was touched.

runs.prompt: Add a String method to Quote in pricing/quote.go that formats a quote as "subtotal 10.00, discount 1.00, tax 1.35, total 10.35", and test it.
runs.finalMessage:
Added `Quote.String()` in [quote.go](/tmp/ostf-trials/phase5/codex.full.go-shop.T12.1/run-08/repo/pricing/quote.go) to produce the requested format, with an exact-output test in [quote_test.go](/tmp/ostf-trials/phase5/codex.full.go-shop.T12.1/run-08/repo/pricing/quote_test.go).

`go test ./...` and `ostf check --base main` pass. The check lists the new draft item **R-QUOTE-STRING**, verified by `TestQuoteString`; the change keeps its parent need **N-FAIR-PRICE** true. It also reports the existing unlinked items **R-ORDER-NOTE** and **R-VOLUME-DISCOUNT**, which this change leaves unchanged. No risk-relevant item was touched.

runs.prompt: Add a function RatePercent to pricing/tax.go that formats a region's rate as a percentage, such as 14.975%, and test it.
runs.finalMessage:
Added `RatePercent(Region) string` in [pricing/tax.go](/private/tmp/ostf-trials/phase5/codex.full.go-shop.T12.1/run-09/repo/pricing/tax.go). It uses integer arithmetic, so `149_750` formats exactly as `14.975%`. [TestRatePercent](/private/tmp/ostf-trials/phase5/codex.full.go-shop.T12.1/run-09/repo/pricing/tax_test.go) covers that value, trailing zeros, zero, and small positive and negative rates.

`go test ./...` and `ostf check --base origin/main` pass. The trace check lists `D-RATES-PPM`, `R-MONEY-CENTS`, and `N-FAIR-PRICE`; this change keeps each true and links `TestRatePercent` to `D-RATES-PPM`. No risk-relevant item was touched.

runs.prompt: Add a function RegionByCode in a new file pricing/regions.go that returns the region for QC (14.975 percent), ON (13 percent) or AB (5 percent), and an error for any other code. Test it.
runs.finalMessage:
Added `RegionByCode` in [pricing/regions.go](/tmp/ostf-trials/phase5/codex.full.go-shop.T12.1/run-10/repo/pricing/regions.go). It returns QC at 14.975%, ON at 13%, and AB at 5%, with an error for any other code. [Tests](/tmp/ostf-trials/phase5/codex.full.go-shop.T12.1/run-10/repo/pricing/regions_test.go) cover all three rates and invalid codes.

`go test ./...` and `ostf check --base main` pass. The check lists the new draft item `R-REGION-BY-CODE`, verified by `TestRegionByCode` and `TestRegionByCodeUnknown`; the change keeps its parent item `N-FAIR-PRICE` true. No risk-relevant item was touched.
